profile.headline: COO
profile.summary: I'm interested in full stack roles where I can lead a team to achieve our goal.  Whether the project is client-facing or internal tooling, I am excited to plan and execute projects that are useful, reliable, and eloquently coded.  I've worked at a variety of companies ranging in industry, company size, and infrastructure. I started my career as a Ruby on Rails back end engineer, but since then I've moved to full stack and team lead roles.  I enjoy helping junior engineers learn and plan their work as well as diving into complex projects of my own.

positions.title: Chief Operating Officer
positions.description: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Product Operations · Technical Project Leadership · Software Product Management

positions.title: Head of Product
positions.description: Skills: Product Development · Product Engineering · User Experience (UX) · User-centered Design · Software Engineering · Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrating REST endpoints to GraphQL in the Ruby on Rails monolith
- Providing meaningful and effective code reviews
- Architecting solutions to issues such as GraphQL error handling
- Managing projects and serving as the point-of-contact for higher level objectives
- Completing major feature development in Ruby and React/Typescript
- Participating in the weekly guild meetings
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · GraphQL · React.js · Next.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer III & Scrum Master
positions.description:
- Implemented a greenfield live-streaming application for virtual fitness classes
- Implemented a video on demand library
- Mentored developers across the organization
- Co-chair of Professional Development in Women In Tech
- Lead internal and external tech talks and workshops

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Started as part of a small, agile team in Austin, Texas.  I worked across the front and back-end of our React.js + Vue.js + Rails application.  My role involved working with multiple teams in different time zones to make thoughtful decisions and deliver secure integrations with various APIs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Mid-level backend engineer, maintaining and improving the REST API, building out integrations and new features in Ruby on Rails, improving search technology using ElasticSearch, and working on creative solutions to create a better product.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed internal and external-facing API documentation using Swagger
- Implemented a Salesforce integration for automatic imports
- Replaced and reformatted legacy code
- Refactored large areas of our API and built out new endpoints
- Updated and improved elastic search
- Implemented features in the front end using Vue.js, React.js, and Jquery

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the move to Agile development
- Implemented Scrum and updated internal tooling
- Managed projects using vanilla JavaScript and jQuery
- Designed and developed a ReactNative application for Android
positions.insights: Skills: Test Driven Development · RSpec · Ruby on Rails · React Native · Scrum

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Third engineer hired at YouEarnedIt
- Rewrote code from ASP.Net to Ruby on Rails
- Developed our CD/CI pipeline and added RSpec and Jasmine
- Deployments using EngineYard and Grunt
- Learned MongoDB
- Developed features in React.js with Redux
- Aided in expanding our customer base from 12K to 100K
positions.insights: Skills: Refactoring · MongoDB · Ruby on Rails · React.js
